file: BP-PY-46-argparse-cli-safe.py
---
import argparse
import sys


def print_result_lines(summary: str) -> None:
    print(summary)


def cmd_check(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    print_result_lines(args.summary)
    return 0


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="check")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    check = sub.add_parser("check")
    check.add_argument("--summary", default="ok")
    check.set_defaults(func=cmd_check)
    return parser


def main() -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args()
    for path in getattr(args, "paths", []):
        print(f"FAIL: file not found: {path}", file=sys.stderr)
    return int(args.func(args))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
